notes: Original studio presets. Every stack is built from Ucupaint COLOR (solid) layers whose masks are computed from the mesh itself (ambient occlusion, edge detection, world-space fake lighting, procedural noise), so a preset lands correctly on any UV-unwrapped model. No settings were copied from Substance 3D Painter or any other paid source; all values below are this studio's own construction. Channel overrides use Ucupaint layer-channel overrides: 'value' entries target VALUE channels (Metallic/Roughness/Height), 'color' entries target the Color channel via the layer solid color.

presets.description: Bright worn metal appears where the mesh has exposed edges (Ucupaint Edge Detect mask, i.e. curvature/edge driven), broken up by fine noise so the wear is not a clean line.
presets.display_name: Edge Wear - Paint to Bare Metal

presets.description: Dark matte grime settles where ambient occlusion says the surface is occluded (crevices, contact shadows). The AO mask is inverted so dirt lives in the cavities, then broken up with mid-scale noise.

A pale, fully rough dust film on surfaces whose normals point up in world space (Ucupaint Fake Lighting / HEMI mask with a +Z vector), feathered by noise so it reads as settled dust rather than a hard cap.

Small high-frequency chips of dark primer/metal break through the paint. A fine noise mask is thresholded with a Ramp modifier into discrete chips, and an Edge Detect mask biases the chipping toward exposed edges.
